parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster that you want to query.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description:
The dimension from which you want to configure the feature. Valid values:

*   **Cluster**: the ID of the cluster

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the feature. Valid values:

*   **containerNetwork**: container network topology
*   **interceptionSwitch**: cluster microsegmentation

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-cluster-basic-info --cluster-id c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --type containerNetwork --target-type Cluster --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeClusterBasicInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Type containerNetwork --ClusterId c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --TargetType Cluster
